name: VOCE Survey Platform
description: The native survey runtime — one definition delivered conversationally, as a web form, or as PDF. Source of record for responses collected in VOCE.

name: Qualtrics
description: Third-party survey platform used by several agencies. Responses are read across for portfolio-wide questions; the instrument stays where it was authored.

name: Microsoft Forms
description: Agency-authored forms in the State's Microsoft tenant. Read-only: VOCE indexes responses without taking ownership of the form.

name: Google Forms
description: Not yet connected. Historical exports are indexed; live response sync is pending an agency data-sharing agreement.

name: Maryland Resident Contact Registry
description: Consent-scoped contact lists used for distribution. Holds delivery receipts, not survey answers — responses are never joined back to a named resident.

name: Service Center Visit Logs
description: Visit and wait-time telemetry by location, used to give open-text themes an operational denominator rather than a sentiment score alone.
